findings.explanation: Lean proves `HD ([] : List Bool) = ARB` by reflexivity. HOL4 saves only `HD (h::t) = h`, which permits either Boolean value for `HD []`, independently of `ARB`. The empty-list branch also makes every out-of-bounds `EL` equal to `ARB` through its recursion on `TL`.
findings.repair:
private opaque hdNil {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : α := ARB

def HD [Nonempty α] : List α → α
  | h :: _ => h
  | [] => hdNil
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.ListLib

example : CmlTS.HD ([] : List Bool) = CmlTS.ARB := rfl
findings.hol4_check: !b:bool. ?f:bool list -> bool. (f [] = b) /\ (!h t. f (h::t) = h)
